what: Unreadable/absent OVERWATCH.json read as 0 open / 0 high, which standards grades HOLDING.
how: Reproduced by reading. _watch now retries the read 3x (0.2 s apart), and on failure sets unreadable=True plus one sentinel HIGH row (open=1, high=1), the same fail-closed pattern as `broken` beside it, so the existing standard fails without touching standards.py (not mine). Optional follow-up for the owner of standards.py: read w['unreadable'] explicitly.

what: A failed halt read rendered 'running -- no halt standing' in the OK colour.
how: safety() now sets halt_unreadable=True in its except; panelSafety draws a 'value bad' 'halt state UNREADABLE' row when it (or a null halted) is seen.

what: --write had no halt interlock (and no shrink guard).
how: Added the standard fail-closed _assert_not_halted (copy of sevenfold's) called on the --write path before build. COORDINATOR: add cosmology_graph.py to verify_math._INTERLOCKED or the roster check will fail. The shrink guard (refuse when fewer pairs than prior) is NOT added: the floor ratio is a judgment call and a real shrink can be legitimate; see Q-F3.

what: ensure() could raise out of the windowless keeper with no log line.
how: start_watchdog() wrapped: logs type and message to autostart.log, silence.note, returns 'start-failed'.

what: --uninstall left the keeper task standing without saying so.
how: Chose the non-destructive option: --uninstall prints that the keeper task still stands and to run --uninstall-task. Did not call uninstall_task() (changes what the command does to the machine).

what: (a) non-integer depth raised out of foreground(); (b) a bad heartbeat aborted status() listing; (c) a crashed same-PID claim inflated depth and survived exit.
how: (a)+(c): the nesting depth is now an in-process counter (_FG_DEPTH under _DEPTH_LOCK); the claim file only publishes it, never read back. (b): per-row try in status(); bad heartbeat gives age_s None. (d) not changed, see question.

what: status() lost every row after one bad heartbeat.
_is_skipped narrower than the .gitignore glob: x.py.pre-sweep, x.py.pre_edit, x.BAK, x.PYC were copied and secret-scanned.
how: _PRE_BACKUP now r'\.pre[^./\]*$' and the SKIP_SUFFIX test is lower-cased. x.pre.old (a mid-name .pre) is still not matched; the glob's wider reach there stays deliberate per gitignore_lines' docstring.

what: Stale comment listing what the dashboard process writes.
how: Comment now names dashboard_history.json and read_progress.json too. No net (comment only).

what: standards_unavailable is written and read by nothing.
how: Options: (a) render it in panelStandards ('standards UNAVAILABLE'), (b) drop the key. Touches publish snapshot schema, so left to owner.

what: _read_row/_roll_row show a dead reader's last line with no age.
how: Option: add log mtime/age to the row. Display design choice.
Options: keep (documented drop), or return nonzero when UNSHELVED is non-empty. Curatorial.

what: No shrink guard on the graph write (F3 second half).
how: Option: refuse to land when pair_count < prior * floor; needs owner to choose the floor and whether a legitimate shrink needs a flag.
Confirm 'non-decreasing' is the intended claim; strict would fail two equal assays.

what: An unreadable halt still spends the hourly start budget.
how: Documented behaviour; options: do not charge the budget when halted is None, or accept.

what: F6d: 240 s yield ceiling and 900 s slot deadline go 'anyway' with no silence.note.
how: A note on every timeout could spike swallowed counts (standards MAX_SWALLOWED_NEW=2000); owner to choose a separate counter or accept a note.
